_comment: Drives test/klippy/delta_calibrate.test under the simavr bridge in tick-mode lockstep, mirroring delta.fixture.json. Same throughput-bound exclusion delta hit in free-run sim_time; tick_mode pins simavr's advance to klippy's reactor cycle so the per-step UART traffic always lands inside the simulated moment it was sent. delta_calibrate.cfg has no thermistors / heaters / sensors past the three towers' endstops, so only auto_trsync_trigger_ticks is needed; analog_in_default is harmless-but-unused. config_overrides rescales rotation_distance from the upstream cfg's fileoutput-symbolic 0.32 to a real-printer 40 mm/rev (GT2 belt, 20-tooth pulley) on the emulator's materialized copy only: at 0.32 with microsteps=16 and homing_speed=50 each tower would need ~500 kHz step pulses, beyond what an atmega2560 can sustain (the AVR correctly trips its stepper-overload shutdown), while the shared cfg that fileoutput CI parses stays byte-identical to upstream. The saved heightN_pos autosave values are rescaled by the same 0.32/40 = 1/125 factor so DELTA_ANALYZE's stable-position math stays self-consistent at config load; the DELTA_CALIBRATE METHOD=manual run the .test drives later overwrites them with fresh probe positions before the extended calibration.
